title: Enhanced electrocatalytic performance of phosphorus and metal oxide-modified graphite electrodes for all-vanadium redox flow batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,341-353
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00381D, Paper

Yassine Seffar, Elhoucine Elmaataouy, Yuri Mikhlin, Melina Zysler, David Zitoun, Jones Alami, Mouad Dahbi
This study evaluates CoO-, NiO-, and oxygen-rich phosphorus–modified graphite powder electrodes to enhance the sluggish VO2+/VO2+ redox kinetics in vanadium redox flow batteries.
